故宫、天坛等核心景区步道平缓、可租轮椅，建议错峰出行并提前在线预约门票。: The Forbidden City and Temple of Heaven have gentle walkways and wheelchair rental; travel outside peak times and book tickets online in advance.
世界现存最大木结构宫殿群，红墙黄瓦适合全家拍照，可提前预约轮椅服务。: The largest surviving wooden palace complex in the world — red walls and golden roofs make a lovely family photo stop, and wheelchair service can be booked ahead.
“不到长城非好汉”，缆车往返省力，老人小孩也能轻松登顶。: “He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true man” — the cable car saves effort, so seniors and children can reach the top comfortably.
本地老人最爱的晨练地，古柏参天、步道平缓，适合陪长辈散步。: A favourite morning exercise spot for locals — ancient cypresses and flat walkways make it ideal for a gentle stroll with your parents.
西湖环线平缓、公交地铁便利；推荐避开周末客流高峰，可租公共自行车或坐游船代步。: The West Lake loop is flat with easy bus and metro access; avoid weekend crowds, and rent a bike or take a boat for a rest.
断桥残雪、苏堤春晓……沿湖步道平缓，可乘电瓶船环湖，最适合陪老人慢慢逛。: Broken Bridge in snow, Su Causeway in spring… the lakeside paths are flat and an electric boat can take you around — perfect for a slow walk with seniors.
梅家坞喝一杯明前龙井，看茶农采茶，亲子互动满分。: Sip pre-Qingming Longjing in Meijiawu and watch the farmers pick tea — a big hit with children.
古刹清幽，香火旺盛，长辈祈福的好去处，注意台阶较多。: A serene old temple with plenty of worshippers and a lovely place for elders to pray — just note there are many steps.
冬季温暖是最大的适老优势；亚龙湾、南山园区平坦，注意防晒与补水，避免正午暴晒。: Warm winters are ideal for older travellers; Yalong Bay and Nanshan are flat. Watch the sun, keep drinking water and avoid the midday heat.
沙细浪缓，海水清澈，是带老人小孩玩水的最佳选择。: Fine sand, gentle waves and clear water — the best place to play in the sea with seniors and children.
潜水与玻璃船观光并存，老人可乘环岛电瓶车轻松游览。: Diving and glass-bottom boats side by side; seniors can tour comfortably by electric shuttle.
108 米海上观音庄严壮观，园区宽敞，适合长辈礼佛散步。: The 108-metre sea Guanyin is majestic, and the wide, flat grounds are ideal for elders to stroll and pray.
市区景点大多平缓；注意饮食以清淡为主，火锅可选鸳鸯锅，湿冷天气备好保暖衣物。: Most city sights are flat; keep meals mild (choose a split hotpot), and bring warm clothes for the damp cold.
早上看滚滚吃竹子最萌，园区平缓，老人孩子都超爱。: Watch pandas munching bamboo in the morning — flat paths and a favourite with both kids and grandparents.
竹椅盖碗茶、掏耳朵，让爸妈体验最地道的成都慢生活。: Bamboo chairs, lidded tea and ear cleaning — let your parents experience the most authentic Chengdu slow life.
青砖黛瓦的川西民居，小吃遍地，晚上灯火辉煌。: Grey-brick Western Sichuan houses, snacks everywhere, and lanterns glowing at night.
以乘船观景为主，步行强度低；山区景区注意台阶与湿滑，雨季备雨具。: Mostly boat sightseeing with little walking; watch the steps in hilly areas, and bring rain gear in the wet season.
从桂林到阳朔的精华段，山水如画，坐船最省力，适合全家。: The classic Guilin–Yangshuo stretch — the most effortless way to see the scenery, great for the whole family.
“小漓江”竹筏漂流，水流平缓，亲子戏水乐趣多。: A gentle “mini Li River” raft ride — calm water and lots of fun for children.
中西合璧的步行街，晚上热闹，适合全家逛吃。: An East-meets-West pedestrian street that comes alive at night — perfect for family eating and browsing.
博物馆、城墙等设施完善，注意行程别太赶；回民街人多，看管好老人小孩。: Museums and the city wall are well equipped; don’t rush the schedule. The Muslim Quarter is crowded, so keep an eye on elders and children.
世界第八大奇迹，馆内平缓有扶梯，长辈也能轻松参观。: The eighth wonder of the world; the halls are flat with escalators, so seniors can visit comfortably.
骑行或坐电瓶车环城，日落时俯瞰古城，氛围拉满。: Cycle or ride an electric cart around the wall — sunset views over the old city are magical.
肉夹馍、羊肉泡馍、甑糕……美食地图在这里展开。: Roujiamo, lamb paomo, sweet rice cakes… the city’s food map unfolds right here.
景区索道/电梯/环保车完善，但山路多台阶，腿脚不便的长辈需评估；建议备登山杖。: Cable cars, lifts and shuttle buses are good, but there are many steps — assess mobility needs and bring a walking stick.
《阿凡达》悬浮山取景地，百龙天梯直达，气势磅礴。: The floating mountains from Avatar; the Bailong Lift takes you straight up for a breathtaking view.
云海与峰林同框，索道+环保车串联，省力不累。: Sea of clouds and pillar peaks — linked by cable car and shuttle bus, so it is easy on the legs.
峡谷溪流平缓，适合亲子徒步吸氧，猕猴常出没。: A gentle valley walk perfect for families; macaques often appear along the path.
老城道路平缓适合散步，海风大记得加外套；夏季是全家避暑首选。: The old town is flat and walkable, but the sea breeze is strong — bring a jacket. A top summer escape for families.
百年地标，海鸥成群，清晨喂海鸥是全家必玩项目。: A century-old landmark with flocks of seagulls; feeding them in the morning is a family must-do.
万国建筑博览区，绿荫红瓦，推着老人散步刚刚好。: A district of villas from many nations with shaded avenues and red roofs — easy walking for seniors.
了解百年酿酒史，凭门票还能领一杯原浆，长辈也能小酌。: A century of brewing history, and your ticket includes a glass of fresh beer — even seniors can sip.
古城石板路对腿脚不便者略颠簸，注意慢行；高海拔地区老人先适应 1-2 天，备好常: The old town’s cobbles are bumpy for those with limited mobility — take it slowly. The altitude is high, so let elders acclimatise for a day or two and bring their medicines.
石板路、小桥流水，住一晚特色客栈，感受纳西慢生活。: Cobbled lanes and canals; stay a night in a courtyard guesthouse and enjoy Naxi slow living.
乘大索道登 4506 米观景台，需备氧气与厚衣，量力而行。: The big cable car reaches a 4,506 m viewing platform — bring oxygen and warm clothes, and know your limits.
高原湖泊，湿地观鸟、骑马划船，轻松惬意。: A plateau lake for birdwatching, horse riding and boating — relaxed and easy.
地铁无障碍完善，博物馆/商场室内空调舒适；夏季注意室内外温差防感冒。: The metro is very accessible and museums and malls are air-conditioned; in summer watch the indoor–outdoor temperature gap.
万国建筑群与陆家嘴天际线隔江相望，夜景是全家合影的经典机位。: Historic waterfront buildings face the Lujiazui skyline across the river — the classic family photo spot at night.
免费预约，馆藏丰富，室内舒适，雨天遛娃首选。: Free with a reservation, rich collections and comfortable indoors — the best rainy-day option with children.
江南园林与城隍庙小吃街，一步一景，边逛边吃。: Classical Jiangnan gardens plus the City God Temple snack street — a view and a bite at every step.
洱海环线坐车观光为主，几乎无强度；注意紫外线与高反，节奏放慢。: Mostly driving around Erhai Lake with almost no walking; watch the strong sun and the altitude, and keep the pace slow.
自驾/包车环洱海，途经喜洲古镇、双廊，风光一路都是明信片。: Drive or charter a car around the lake past Xizhou and Shuanglang — postcard views the whole way.
白族民居、人民路小酒馆，节奏极慢，适合陪爸妈闲逛。: Bai-style houses and small bars on Renmin Road — a very slow pace, great for wandering with your parents.
乘索道上山看杜鹃花海，远眺洱海全景。: Take the cable car up for rhododendron meadows and panoramic views over Erhai Lake.
山城坡坎多、台阶多，带长辈建议多打车/轻轨；夏季酷热避免正午外出。: The mountain city means slopes and stairs — use taxis and the monorail with seniors. Summers are very hot, so avoid midday outings.
千与千寻同款吊脚楼夜景，江边灯火璀璨，记得占好观景位。: Spirited-Away-style stilt houses lit up at night above the river — grab a good viewpoint.
空中过江的“山城空中巴士”，横跨两岸，全家必体验。: The “mountain-city sky bus” across the river — a must-try for the whole family.
石板老街、陈麻花与鸡杂，边逛边吃老重庆味道。: Stone-paved lanes, Chen Mahua twists and chicken gizzards — old Chongqing flavour as you stroll.
市区平缓，开元寺、西街步行友好；海鲜街市注意肠胃。: The city centre is flat and Kaiyuan Temple and West Street are walkable; take care with seafood if you have a sensitive stomach.
千年古刹与宋代石塔，庭院清幽，适合长辈礼佛散步。: A thousand-year-old temple with Song-dynasty stone pagodas and quiet courtyards — lovely for elders to stroll.
面线糊、土笋冻、润饼……一条街吃遍闽南味。: Mianxianhu noodles, sea worm jelly, runbing rolls… eat your way through Minnan flavours on one street.
簪花围、蚵壳厝，体验\"头上花园\"的渔村浪漫。: Flower headdresses and oyster-shell houses — the romantic fishing village of the “garden on your head”.
环海路平缓、可骑行，海边风大注意防风。: The coastal road is flat and cyclable; the seaside wind is strong, so dress for it.
甲午故地，岛上绿树成荫，乘船半小时即达。: A historic island from the First Sino-Japanese War, green and shaded, half an hour away by boat.
沿海慢行或骑行，一路海天一色，随手都是明信片。: Walk or cycle beside the sea — postcard views at every turn.
沙细水清，傍晚看落日，孩子挖沙玩水正合适。: Fine sand and clear water; sunset is lovely and children can dig in the sand.
云冈石窟、悬空寺均有游览车/索道，减少步行。: Both the Yungang Grottoes and the Hanging Temple have shuttle carts or cable cars to reduce walking.
世界文化遗产，5.9 万尊造像气势恢宏，有电瓶车代步。: A UNESCO World Heritage site with 59,000 carvings; electric carts save the walking.
建于悬崖上的千年寺庙，登临需走台阶，远观亦震撼。: A thousand-year-old temple built into a cliff; climbing means steps, but it is striking from below too.
可骑行或电瓶车环城，傍晚看古城灯火。: Cycle or take an electric cart around it, and see the old city lit up in the evening.
大峡谷台阶较多，腿脚不便的长辈建议只走精华段或乘观光电梯。: The Grand Canyon has many steps — with limited mobility, walk only the highlights or take the sightseeing lift.
绝壁栈道、一炷香，云海翻涌时如同仙境。: Cliff walkways and the Incense Stick rock — a fairyland when the sea of clouds rolls in.
\"悬浮船\"网红打卡地，清澈见底的翡翠水。: The famous “floating boat” photo spot with crystal-clear emerald water.
土家风情街市，晚上有民俗表演，老少皆宜。: A Tujia-style market street with evening folk performances — fun for all ages.
热海温泉、和顺古镇节奏舒缓，特别适合陪长辈放松。: The Hot Sea springs and Heshun Old Town are slow-paced — perfect for relaxing with elders.
大滚锅地热蒸腾，泡汤祛寒，长辈最爱。: Steaming geothermal pools — a warm soak is a favourite with seniors.
11 月满村银杏金黄，拍照超出片。: In November the whole village turns golden — superb photos.
图书馆、洗衣亭、老宅水田，田园牧歌般清净。: Library, laundry pavilions, old houses and rice fields — pastoral and peaceful.
古窑、陶溪川以室内为主，步道平缓。: The ancient kiln sites and Taoxichuan are mostly indoors with flat walkways.
看非遗匠人现场制瓷，感受千年窑火。: Watch master craftsmen at work and feel a thousand years of kiln fire.
老厂房改造的文创街区，夜晚灯火很有氛围。: A creative quarter converted from old factory buildings — lovely lighting at night.
明清皇家瓷厂遗址，博物馆里藏着历代瓷器精品。: The site of the Ming-Qing imperial kilns, with fine porcelain in the museum.
柳江夜游、公园平缓；螺蛳粉辣度可选不辣。: The Liujiang night cruise and parks are flat; luosifen can be ordered not spicy.
来柳州必须来一碗正宗的，本地小店最地道。: A bowl of authentic luosifen is a must — the small local shops are the best.
乘船夜游柳江，看蟠龙山瀑布灯光秀。: Cruise the river at night for the Panshan waterfall light show.
侗族风雨桥与鼓楼，山水田园间的民族风情。: Dong wind-and-rain bridges and drum towers amid rice-field scenery.
古城以平缓步行为主，可坐电瓶车代步；石板路注意防滑。: The old town is mostly flat walking with electric carts available; take care on the stone-paved lanes.
登墙俯瞰整座古城，黄昏时分最有味道。: Climb the wall for views over the whole old town — magical at dusk.
中国第一家票号，看晋商如何\"汇通天下\"。: China’s first draft bank — see how Shanxi merchants moved money across the empire.
城外彩塑艺术宝库，两千余尊造像栩栩如生。: A treasure house of painted sculpture outside town with 2,000 lifelike figures.
古镇平缓、竹海有接驳车，整体轻松。: The old town is flat and the bamboo forest has shuttle buses — an easy day overall.
中西合璧的江南水乡，人少景美，摇橹船慢游。: A Jiangnan water town blending Chinese and Western architecture — quiet, pretty and best seen by rowing boat.
《卧虎藏龙》取景地，竹海步道清凉洗肺。: A Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon location — cool, fresh bamboo trails.
竹林民宿与山间绿道，亲子骑行正合适。: Bamboo guesthouses and mountain trails — great for family cycling.
大佛有游船观景路线，免爬栈道；峨眉山可坐索道。: See the Buddha from a boat to avoid the cliff stairs, and take the cable car up Mount Emei.
乘船看大佛全貌最省力，气势震撼。: A boat gives the easiest full view of the Buddha — truly impressive.
索道+金顶，云海日出美如仙境（注意高反与保暖）。: Cable car to the Golden Summit for cloud seas and sunrises — bring warm layers.
蒸汽小火车穿越油菜花田，童趣满满。: A steam train through rapeseed fields — pure childhood delight.
土楼景区有观光车；海岛路况良好，节奏可慢。: The tulou sites have shuttle carts and the island roads are easy — take it slow.
四菜一汤、云水谣，客家圆楼的震撼与温情。: The “four dishes and a soup” cluster and Yunshuiyao — Hakka round houses at their most moving.
风动石、南门湾，海风与彩色渔村。: Wind-moving rock, Nanmen Bay, sea breeze and colourful fishing villages.
骑楼老街与闽南小吃，烟火气十足。: Arcade streets and Minnan snacks — full of everyday life.
银滩平缓、老街好逛，冬天带爸妈避寒很合适。: Silver Beach is flat and the old street is easy to stroll — a great winter escape with parents.
平缓细腻的\"天下第一滩\"，挖沙玩水一整天。: The famously fine, flat “number one beach” — a whole day of sand and sea.
火山岩海岸与清澈海水，环岛看日出日落。: Volcanic coastline and clear water; circle the island for sunrise and sunset.
百年骑楼老街，虾饼与糖水的老城味道。: A century-old arcade street with shrimp cakes and sweet soups.
鼓浪屿、环岛路平缓；海滨注意防晒。: Gulangyu and the Island Ring Road are flat; watch the sun by the sea.
万国建筑与小巷琴声，步行一天刚好。: International architecture and piano music in the lanes — a perfect day on foot.
骑行或漫步，看海天一色。: Cycle or stroll where the sea meets the sky.
老渔港改造的文艺街区，咖啡馆与创意小店。: An old fishing harbour turned artsy quarter with cafés and design shops.
滨海路、星海广场平缓；海风大注意防风。: The coastal road and Xinghai Square are flat; the breeze is strong, so dress for wind.
依山傍海的城市风光带，木栈道适合散步。: A scenic route between hills and sea with a boardwalk made for strolling.
亚洲最大城市广场，看海喂海鸥。: One of Asia’s largest city squares — sea views and seagulls.
海洋公园亲子必去，表演精彩。: A must for families: a marine park with great shows.
地铁发达、茶楼舒适，特别适合陪长辈吃早茶。: Excellent metro and comfortable teahouses — ideal for morning tea with elders.
一盅两件，从早吃到午的广式生活方式。: “One pot, two bites” — the Cantonese way to eat from morning to noon.
欧陆风情建筑群，绿荫下散步拍照。: European-style buildings and leafy avenues — lovely for a walk and photos.
华灯初上，看小蛮腰与两岸夜景。: See the Canton Tower and both banks lit up after dark.
中山陵、玄武湖平缓开阔；梧桐大道适合散步。: Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum and Xuanwu Lake are open and flat; the plane-tree avenues are made for walking.
392级台阶登顶俯瞰，气势恢宏。: 392 steps to sweeping views from the top.
城中大湖，泛舟散步皆宜。: A big lake in the city — good for boating or walking.
夜游秦淮，看灯火桨声。: Cruise the Qinhuai at night amid lanterns and oars.
园林步道平缓，适合长辈慢慢逛。: The garden paths are flat — easy for elders to wander slowly.
中国四大名园之首，一步一景。: The finest of China’s four great gardens — a view at every step.
水巷并行，坐摇橹船听评弹。: A canal-side lane; take a rowing boat and listen to pingtan ballad singing.
乘船观湖，吃太湖三白。: Boat out on the lake and try the “three whites” of Taihu.
五大道、海河沿线平缓；相声茶馆适合长辈。: Wudadao and the Haihe riverside are flat; the crosstalk teahouses suit elders.
万国建筑博物馆，骑行或马车游览。: An open-air museum of world architecture — tour by bike or horse carriage.
乘船夜游，看两岸灯火。: Cruise at night for the lights on both banks.
天津卫的快乐，听一场就懂。: Tianjin’s idea of fun — one show and you’ll get it.
冬季冰雪路面注意防滑保暖；室内外温差大。: In winter the icy streets need grippy shoes and warm layers; the indoor–outdoor temperature gap is big.
冬日冰雕王国，梦幻璀璨。: A winter kingdom of ice sculptures — dreamy and glittering.
面包石街道与俄式建筑，马迭尔冰棍必吃。: A cobbled street of Russian-style buildings — the Modern ice pop is a must.
绿顶洋葱头教堂，夜景很美。: The green onion-domed cathedral is beautiful at night.
岳麓山、橘子洲步道完善；辣度可调。: Yuelu Mountain and Orange Isle have good walkways; spiciness can be adjusted.
看青年毛主席雕像，周末有烟花。: See the statue of the young Mao; weekend fireworks in season.
千年学府，爱晚亭看红叶。: A thousand-year-old academy, with autumn maples at Aiwan Pavilion.
臭豆腐、糖油粑粑，越夜越热闹。: Stinky tofu and sweet rice cakes — the later, the livelier.
东湖绿道平缓；博物馆室内舒适。: The East Lake greenway is flat and the museums are comfortable indoors.
登楼望长江，看古今同框。: Climb for Yangtze views where old and new meet.
中国最大城中湖，骑行樱花季最美。: China’s largest urban lake — best cycled in cherry-blossom season.
热干面、豆皮，过早一条街。: Hot dry noodles and bean skin — the classic breakfast street.
三坊七巷平缓、老城好逛，适合陪长辈。: Three Lanes and Seven Alleys are flat and the old town is easy to stroll with elders.
中国城市里坊制度活化石，名人辈出。: A living fossil of Chinese lane-neighbourhood planning, and home to many famous figures.
\"温泉之都\"，泡汤放松。: The “city of hot springs” — soak and unwind.
城中古园林，秋看菊花展。: An old city park; chrysanthemum shows in autumn.
普陀山、桃花岛船程平缓；注意晕船。: Boat rides to Putuo Mountain and Peach Blossom Island are gentle; bring seasickness medicine if needed.
海天佛国，观音道场，香火与海风。: The Buddhist island of Guanyin — incense and sea breeze.
渔村与灯塔，看海上日出。: Fishing villages and lighthouses — sunrise over the sea.
吃一顿现捞海鲜，夜排档热闹。: Fresh seafood and lively night stalls.
老城骑楼平缓；肠胃敏感备药。: The old-town arcades are flat; bring medicine if you have a sensitive stomach.
百年商埠的骑楼群，复古好拍。: The arcades of a century-old trading port — great retro photos.
环岛看灯塔与海湾，吃海鲜。: Circle the island for lighthouses, bays and seafood.
现切现涮，潮汕人的讲究。: Sliced and poached to order — the Chaoshan way.
海边栈道平缓；注意防晒。: The seaside boardwalks are flat; watch the sun.
\"八仙过海\"传说地，海市蜃楼。: The legendary home of the Eight Immortals — and of mirages.
海上仙山，看海鸥与日落。: Islands of legend — seagulls and sunsets.
百年葡萄酒庄园，品酒参观。: A century-old winery open for tours and tastings.
日月湾平缓；注意防晒补水。: Riyue Bay is flat; watch the sun and drink plenty of water.
中国冲浪胜地，海边咖啡店看海。: China’s surf capital — watch the waves from a beach café.
认识热带植物，喝地道兴隆咖啡。: Learn about tropical plants and try real Xinglong coffee.
\"海南最美海湾\"之一，人少沙细。: One of Hainan’s loveliest bays — few people, fine sand.
北戴河海滨平缓；老龙头台阶注意。: Beidaihe’s seafront is flat; mind the steps at Laolongtou.
天下第一关，城墙下听历史。: The “First Pass Under Heaven” — history beneath the walls.
万里长城唯一入海处，壮阔。: Where the Great Wall meets the sea — spectacular.
老牌避暑胜地，看日出吃海鲜。: The classic summer resort — sunrises and seafood.
园林平缓、早茶舒适，特别适合陪长辈。: Flat gardens and comfortable morning tea — ideal with elders.
\"两堤花柳全依水\"，江南园林典范。: “Two causeways of blossom along the water” — a model Jiangnan garden.
以竹石取胜，四季假山一园看尽。: Famous for bamboo and rocks, with rockeries representing all four seasons.
烫干丝、蟹黄汤包，早茶文化源远流长。: Shredded dried tofu and crab-roe soup dumplings — a long morning-tea tradition.
水乡平缓、可坐乌篷船，适合长辈。: The water town is flat and you can ride a wupeng boat — good for elders.
三味书屋与百草园，课本里的童年。: Sanwei Study and Baicao Garden — childhood straight from the textbooks.
宋代园林，夜游有实景演出。: A Song-dynasty garden with evening performances.
乌篷船穿行崖壁水潭，别有洞天。: Glide by wupeng boat between cliffs and pools.
古城石板路注意防滑；沱江边平缓。: Take care on the old town’s stone lanes; the Tuo River bank is flat.
吊脚楼灯火倒映江面，如梦似幻。: Stilt houses reflected in the water — dreamlike.
古城地标，登桥看全城。: The old town’s landmark — climb it for the full view.
银饰与歌舞，感受苗族风情。: Silver jewellery, song and dance — Miao culture.
高海拔注意防高反；景点车程长备晕车药。: The altitude is high, so take it easy; drives between sights are long, so bring motion-sickness medicine.
高原湖泊与牧场，徒步洗肺。: Plateau lakes and meadows — clean air and easy trails.
\"小布达拉宫\"，金顶气势恢宏。: The “little Potala” with a magnificent golden roof.
藏式古城，转经筒祈福。: A Tibetan old town — spin the prayer wheels.
海拔 2000-3000 米需防高反；景区观光车+木质栈道完善，节奏放慢、备好氧: At 2,000–3,000 m watch for altitude sickness; shuttle buses and wooden boardwalks are excellent — slow down and bring oxygen and a warm coat.

湖水蓝绿相间、晶莹剔透，是九寨沟的精华所在，沿平缓栈道漫步即可饱览。: Turquoise and emerald water at its clearest — the essence of Jiuzhaigou, enjoyed from gentle boardwalks.
中国最宽的钙华瀑布之一，水雾弥漫、气势磅礴，观景平台视野极佳。: One of China’s widest travertine waterfalls — misty and powerful, with superb viewing platforms.
毗邻的黄龙以钙华彩池闻名，层层叠叠如大地调色盘，雪山倒映美不胜收。: Nearby Huanglong is famed for its terraced travertine pools — like a giant palette, with snow peaks reflected in them.

盆地气候，秋冬多雾湿冷，夏季闷热: Basin climate: foggy, damp and chilly in autumn and winter, muggy in summer.

北京是带孩子和父母感受中华文化的首选：故宫的威严、长城的壮阔、胡同里的烟火气，一: Beijing is the top choice for showing kids and grandparents Chinese culture: the Forbidden City, the Great Wall and hutong life add up to one memory-packed family trip. The metro reaches everywhere and the sights are well set up for older visitors.
“上有天堂，下有苏杭”。杭州的节奏很慢，西湖边推着老人散步、陪孩子喂鸽子，是典型: “Above there is heaven; below there are Suzhou and Hangzhou.” Hangzhou moves slowly — stroll West Lake with your parents, feed the pigeons with the kids: a classic relaxed destination for all ages.
三亚是国内最合适的“避寒”家庭目的地。冬季二十几度的温暖、细腻的沙滩和成熟的服务: Sanya is China’s best winter-warmth family destination: 20-plus-degree days, fine sandy beaches and mature tourist facilities — ideal for wintering with parents or a Spring Festival family trip.
成都把“适合全家”写进了骨子里：大熊猫让所有人回归童真，茶馆公园让长辈悠闲自在，: Chengdu is built for families: pandas bring out everyone’s inner child, teahouses and parks let elders relax, and hotpot and skewers satisfy the whole family.
桂林的美在山水之间。乘船漓江、骑行遇龙河、夜逛阳朔，节奏舒缓、风景治愈，是很适合: Guilin’s beauty lies in its landscape: cruise the Li River, cycle the Yulong River and wander Yangshuo at night — gentle, soothing scenery that suits older travellers.
西安是给全家人上“历史课”的最好课堂。兵马俑的震撼、城墙的厚重、回民街的烟火气，: Xi’an is the best history classroom for the whole family: the Terracotta Army, the solid city wall and the bustle of the Muslim Quarter show thirteen dynasties in a single trip.
张家界把“奇”字写进每一座山峰。带家人坐百龙天梯直上云霄、穿行云雾峰林，是一场震: Zhangjiajie writes the word “extraordinary” into every peak. Ride the Bailong Lift up into the clouds and walk among misty sandstone pillars — a breathtaking natural experience for the family.
青岛把德式老城与海洋温柔地叠在一起。陪父母在八大关林荫下散步，带孩子去海边挖沙，: Qingdao layers a German-era old town onto the sea. Stroll shady Badaguan with your parents, dig in the sand with the kids, then enjoy a seafood dinner — a perfect family summer.
丽江适合放慢脚步。在古城客栈的院子里晒太阳、去雪山脚下看云海，是逃离城市、陪伴家: Lijiang is made for slowing down: sun yourself in an old-town courtyard, then watch the clouds roll in beneath the snow mountains — a gentle escape from the city with your family.
上海把繁华与烟火气收进同一条街：外滩看世界、豫园尝小吃、博物馆长知识，三代人的上: Shanghai folds glamour and everyday life into the same street: the Bund for the skyline, Yu Garden for snacks and museums for learning — three generations each find their own highlight.
大理的“慢”是治愈的。环洱海看云、逛古镇晒太阳、吃一顿白族酸辣鱼，全家人都能在苍: Dali’s slowness is healing: drive around Erhai Lake, bask in the old town and try Bai-style sour-spicy fish — the whole family can unwind between mountain and lake.
重庆是立体的：轻轨穿楼、索道过江、火锅沸腾、夜景璀璨。带全家人体验 8D 魔幻城: Chongqing is three-dimensional: monorails through buildings, cable cars over the river, bubbling hotpot and glittering night views — an 8-D city full of surprises, eating by day and sightseeing by night.
泉州是\"宋元中国的世界海洋商贸中心\"，红砖古厝、千年开元寺、簪花渔村，还有满: Quanzhou was the maritime trade hub of Song-Yuan China: red-brick old houses, the thousand-year Kaiyuan Temple, flower-decked fishing villages and streets of Minnan snacks — slow-paced and warm, wonderful for wandering with your parents.
威海人少景美，海水干净。刘公岛看历史、环海路吹海风、浴场挖沙赶海，节奏轻松，是全: Weihai is quiet and clean: history on Liugong Island, sea breezes along the coastal road and beachcombing at the bathing beach — an easy summer escape for the family.
大同是北魏古都，云冈石窟的千年石刻、悬空寺的奇险、古城墙的厚重，游客不多、物价实: Datong is a Northern Wei capital: the millennium carvings of the Yungang Grottoes, the daring Hanging Temple and the solid old city wall — few crowds and fair prices, ideal for history-loving families.
恩施把\"仙本那\"般的屏山峡谷、奇绝的大峡谷和土家女儿城装进一座城，是摄影与探: Enshi packs the Semporna-like Pingshan Canyon, the dramatic Grand Canyon and Tujia Daughter City into one city — a favourite for photographers and adventurers.
腾冲有火山热海的地热奇观、秋天满村金黄的银杏、安静的和顺古镇，还有边境侨乡的慢时: Tengchong offers volcanic hot springs, a village of golden ginkgos in autumn and the quiet Heshun Old Town — the ideal place to soak and unwind with your parents.
在景德镇，全家可以一起拉坯、画瓷、烧窑，带走一件独一无二的\"家传瓷器\"；古窑: In Jingdezhen the whole family can throw a pot, paint porcelain and fire a kiln, taking home a one-of-a-kind heirloom; the Ancient Kiln museum and Taoxichuan’s night views each have their own charm.
柳州不止有螺蛳粉：百里柳江十里画廊、程阳八寨的侗族风雨桥，还有满城紫荆花，好吃好: Liuzhou is more than luosifen: the Liujiang river scenery, the Dong wind-and-rain bridges of Chengyang and streets of redbud blossom — tasty, fun and affordable.
平遥古城完整保留明清格局，城墙、票号、镖局、县衙一应俱全，仿佛时光倒流，适合带长: Pingyao keeps its Ming-Qing layout intact: walls, draft banks, escort agencies and the county office — like travelling back in time, great for nostalgia with elders and eye-opening for children.
相比乌镇西塘，南浔更清净；安吉的万顷竹海、莫干山的绿意，让湖州成为江南\"避人潮: Compared with Wuzhen and Xitang, Nanxun is quieter; with Anji’s vast bamboo forest and Moganshan’s greenery, Huzhou is Jiangnan’s hidden escape from the crowds.
乐山大佛\"佛是一座山\"，游船远观最震撼；登峨眉金顶看云海日出，还有嘉阳小火车: Leshan’s Giant Buddha is “a Buddha that is a mountain”, best seen from a boat; then the Golden Summit of Mount Emei for cloud seas and sunrises, plus the Jiayang steam train through rapeseed fields — one route for the whole family.
漳州把《大鱼海棠》同款土楼群、马銮湾的碧海和骑楼老街装在一起，游客不多，很适合慢: Zhangzhou combines Big Fish & Begonia-style tulou, the blue sea of Malun Bay and arcade old streets — few tourists and perfect for a slow family trip.
北海银滩\"滩长平、沙细白\"，冬季依然温暖；涠洲岛的火山地貌与玻璃海更是宝藏，: Beihai’s Silver Beach is long, flat and fine-sanded, and winters stay warm; Weizhou Island’s volcanic coast and glassy seas make it superb value for a seaside holiday.
城在海上、海在城中，鼓浪屿的琴声、沙坡尾的文艺、中山路的美食，厦门是把\"度假感: The city sits on the sea and the sea sits in the city: piano music on Gulangyu, the artsy lanes of Shapowei and the food of Zhongshan Road — Xiamen is a holiday packaged as a city.
大连有浪漫的滨海路、异域风情的老建筑和新鲜的海鲜，是北方家庭的避暑首选。: Dalian has a romantic coastal road, old buildings with foreign flair and very fresh seafood — the north’s favourite summer escape for families.
广州的早茶、骑楼、花市和珠江夜景，把岭南的生活气息浓缩成一座城，长辈最爱。: Guangzhou’s morning tea, arcade streets, flower markets and Pearl River nights distil Lingnan life into one city — a favourite with elders.
中山陵的庄严、梧桐大道的浪漫、夫子庙的烟火，南京是带孩子和长辈读\"金陵史\"的: The dignity of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum, the romance of the plane-tree avenues and the bustle of Confucius Temple — Nanjing is a wonderful place to read Jinling’s history with children and elders.
拙政园的匠心、平江路的摇橹、太湖的浩渺，苏州把\"江南\"两个字做到了极致。: The craft of the Humble Administrator’s Garden, rowing boats on Pingjiang Road and the vastness of Taihu Lake — Suzhou takes the idea of “Jiangnan” to its limit.
五大道的小洋楼、海河之眼摩天轮、茶馆里的相声，天津把\"幽默\"过成了日子。: Wudadao’s villas, the Haihe Ferris wheel and crosstalk in teahouses — Tianjin has turned humour into a way of life.
冬天的冰雪大世界、夏天的太阳岛、一年四季的中央大街与俄式美食，哈尔滨总有理由去一: Ice and Snow World in winter, Sun Island in summer, and Central Street with Russian food all year round — Harbin always has a reason to visit.
长沙的夜宵文化、橘子洲的烟火、岳麓书院的千年文脉，让这座城永远年轻。: Changsha’s late-night food culture, the buzz of Orange Isle and the thousand-year Yuelu Academy keep this city forever young.
武汉的\"过早\"文化、长江与东湖的江湖气、江汉关的百年建筑，值得为一口热干面而: Wuhan’s breakfast culture, the river-and-lake character of the Yangtze and East Lake, and the century-old customs house — worth coming for a bowl of hot dry noodles.
三坊七巷的明清古建、温泉古都的历史、闽菜的清鲜，福州是一座\"有福气\"的慢城。: Ming-Qing architecture in Three Lanes and Seven Alleys, a history as a hot-spring capital and the fresh flavours of Fujian cuisine — Fuzhou is a blessed slow city.
舟山群岛是\"海钓天堂\"与佛教圣地，普陀山的梵音、嵊泗的渔村、鲜活的海鲜，宁静: The Zhoushan islands are a sea-fishing paradise and a Buddhist holy place: chanting on Mount Putuo, fishing villages on Shengsi and very fresh seafood — calm and restorative.
汕头是潮汕美食的大本营：牛肉火锅、生腌、蚝烙、工夫茶，配上骑楼老街，吃得停不下来: Shantou is the home of Chaoshan food: beef hotpot, raw-marinated seafood, oyster omelette and gongfu tea, all beside arcade old streets — you will not stop eating.
烟台有蓬莱阁的仙气、长岛的海鸥与礁石、张裕酒庄的葡萄园，是山东的另一片海。: Yantai offers the otherworldly Penglai Pavilion, the seagulls and reefs of Changdao and the vineyards of Changyu — Shandong’s other sea.
万宁有日月湾的冲浪浪点、兴隆的温泉与咖啡，比三亚更安静、更年轻。: Wanning has the surf of Riyue Bay and the hot springs and coffee of Xinglong — quieter and younger than Sanya.
山海关\"天下第一关\"、老龙头长城入海、北戴河的避暑海滩，历史与海风同在。: Shanhaiguan, the “First Pass Under Heaven”, the Great Wall meeting the sea at Laolongtou and Beidaihe’s summer beaches — history and sea breeze together.
瘦西湖的婉约、个园的四季假山、富春茶社的早茶，扬州把\"慢\"活成了生活方式。: Slender West Lake’s grace, Ge Garden’s seasonal rockeries and morning tea at Fuchun — Yangzhou has turned slowness into a way of life.
乌篷船划过鲁迅故里、沈园的陆游唐婉、咸亨酒店的茴香豆，绍兴是江南文脉的缩影。: Wupeng boats glide past Lu Xun’s hometown, Shen Garden’s famous lovers and the fava beans of Xianheng Tavern — Shaoxing is Jiangnan’s literary heart in miniature.
沈从文笔下的边城，沱江吊脚楼、虹桥夜景、苗寨银饰，文艺又出片。: The border town of Shen Congwen’s novels: stilt houses on the Tuo River, Rainbow Bridge at night and silver jewellery in Miao villages — literary and photogenic.
普达措的湖光、松赞林寺的金顶、独克宗古城的经幡，香格里拉是离天堂最近的地方。: Potatso’s lakes, Songzanlin Monastery’s golden roof and the prayer flags of Dukezong — Shangri-La is the closest place to heaven.
九寨沟以翠海、叠瀑、彩林、雪峰、藏情闻名于世，是世界自然遗产和童话般的人间仙境。: Jiuzhaigou is world-famous for its emerald lakes, cascading waterfalls, colourful forests, snow peaks and Tibetan culture — a UNESCO World Heritage site and a fairytale landscape. Ride the shuttle between shimmering lakes; in autumn every step looks like a wallpaper.
